n5dd005f648.headline: European stocks rise on hopes of Fed pause, Prosus slides on China woes
n5dd005f648.summary: European stocks rose on hopes that the Federal Reserve may pause rate rises, though UBS cautioned the pause depends on inflation fading and the labour market cooling. Prosus slid on China-related woes.
n5dd005f648.why: Prosus is a Netherlands-listed investment group with large holdings in Chinese internet company Tencent, so its share price is sensitive to China sentiment. Fed policy shapes global risk appetite and equity valuations.

nbbc1d68d7e.headline: EDPR inaugurates a new wind farm in Poland
nbbc1d68d7e.summary: EDP Renováveis has inaugurated a new wind farm in Poland with a total capacity of 70 MW. The facility will produce enough energy to power more than 85,000 households.
nbbc1d68d7e.why: EDP Renováveis is a Portuguese-listed renewable energy developer, and its project completions add to contracted clean power capacity.

nacab357dad.headline: Leading European financial institutions support H2 Green Steel
nacab357dad.summary: H2 Green Steel said leading European financial institutions have supported its €3.5 billion debt financing. The company is developing green steel production.
nacab357dad.why: H2 Green Steel is a Swedish startup planning hydrogen-based steel production to cut carbon emissions from steelmaking. Large debt financing is a key milestone for capital-intensive industrial projects.

nb68b95f3fc.headline: Dare you look? Next week's diesel, petrol price hikes are ominous...
nb68b95f3fc.summary: Diesel and petrol prices in South Africa are set to rise sharply in November, following next week's pump price hikes, according to The South African.
nb68b95f3fc.why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs and inflation, which in turn influence the South African Reserve Bank's interest-rate decisions.

nee36bd745a.headline: Greek Public Debt Management Agency (PDMA) reissues 5-year bond
nee36bd745a.summary: The Greek Public Debt Management Agency is reissuing a 5-year bond, with a €750 million auction scheduled for Tuesday. The sale is a routine government funding operation.
nee36bd745a.why: Greek government bond auctions set borrowing costs and signal sovereign market access for the Greek state and eurozone periphery debt.

n7249fc9d33.headline: Petrol and diesel price hike for Mzansi motorists NEXT WEEK
n7249fc9d33.summary: Petrol and diesel prices in South Africa will increase next week, according to the latest data published by the Central Energy Fund. The increase affects motorists nationwide.
n7249fc9d33.why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs, inflation and consumer spending, and the Central Energy Fund publishes the data used to set South African fuel price adjustments.
